5f010c86-5115-4faf-9af4-96d6fe1c4da0.description: Gross revenue, then contra, then net as the closing section, each listing only its own rows, with the tab's Breakdown selection cutting inside them. Columns are the periods, newest first; row labels stay pinned while the cells scroll.

4894777a-67cb-477a-b3e1-db7ee6f33966.description: MRR movements per period, stacked by the tab's Breakdown selection. New and expansion stack up, contraction and churn down, so the bar's balance is the change. Each movement type keeps one colour whatever it is split by.

fc43dd0e-7d77-4eb5-a2fc-a4bc11e017ce.title: MRR details
fc43dd0e-7d77-4eb5-a2fc-a4bc11e017ce.description: The MRR waterfall per period. Summary first (starting MRR, change, ending MRR), then the movements (new, expansion, contraction, churn), with the tab's Breakdown selection cutting inside them. Periods run across the top, newest first; the section and line columns stay pinned while the values scroll.

a97818ee-b9a1-44ee-b606-bb172bc78aa0.description: Credit movements pivoted by currency and credit type, newest period first, with empty cells densified to 0. The Credits metric selector switches between credits volume and monetary value.

04f1db3a-1c35-4981-bccd-cc73ba114af1.description: One row per payment intent with customer, invoice, method and error context, newest first.

b623e7c7-b940-4cb6-bc77-e379d932df7e.description: Finalized invoice totals per period, stacked by invoice type and currency. Each invoice type keeps one color across currencies, pinned in the dashboard label_colors.
